limitations_noted: Development pilot synthetic data: fictional entities only; no external employer verification or expert gold relevance claims.
Candidate template leakage: recurring 6-section/2-job archetypes retained per HR-SOURCE-009; candidate index/ordering must be excluded from scoring features.
Summary tenure discrepancies preserved per HR-SOURCE-008: downstream relevance labels must derive job-related tenure from explicit role tasks/dates rather than summary claims.
Presence-only structured skills schema: basic/introductory qualifiers in prose are omitted in skills array; evaluation must reference source text context.
Lexical duplicate detection: 5-gram token overlap does not verify semantic independence or test set contamination against AI1.
